gloss: to drag out; to haul out

definitions.gloss: to drag out; to haul out
definitions.explanation: to forcibly pull something or someone out of a place by dragging

definitions.gloss: to force out; to bring to light
definitions.explanation: to compel someone to come out or to expose something hidden

examples.english: I dragged the dog out from under the sofa.

examples.english: To haul heavy luggage out of the car.

examples.japanese: ⟦{倒|たお}れた→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{燃|も}えている→燃える：02312_moeru⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{引|ひ}きずり{出|だ}して⟦{助|たす}けた→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧。

examples.english: They dragged out the hiding criminal.

examples.english: The media dug up and reported on the politician's past scandal.

notes:
A compound verb combining ⟦{引|ひ}きずる→引きずる：06045_hikizuru⟧ (to drag) and ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to take out). The physical sense implies forceful, rough pulling. The figurative sense conveys forcibly exposing something hidden or compelling someone reluctant to appear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}きずり{出|だ}す — to drag out a criminal
- ⟦{真実|しんじつ}→真実：05316_shinjitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}きずり{出|だ}す — to drag out the truth
- ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{引|ひ}きずり{出|だ}す — to drag someone out of bed
- スキャンダル⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}きずり{出|だ}す — to unearth a scandal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{引|ひ}っ{張|ぱ}り→引っ張る：02402_hipparu⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ — to pull out (less forceful, can be positive: "to recruit")
- ⟦{引|ひ}きずる→引きずる：06045_hikizuru⟧ — to drag (no directional element)
- ⟦{暴|あば}く→暴く：04607_abaku⟧ — to expose, to reveal (secrets or wrongdoing)
